description: Header file for radio station monitoring module, declaring functions related to updating, initializing, destroying, debugging, and retrieving devices for radio station monitoring component.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_updateActive
methods.description: Updates the active status of the radio station monitor.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_init
methods.description: Initializes the radio station monitor with given radio data.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_destroy
methods.description: Destroys and cleans up the radio station monitor associated with the radio data.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_debug
methods.description: Outputs debugging information of the radio station monitor.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getNonAssociatedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a non-associated device based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getMonitorDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a monitor device based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getDevice
methods.description: Gets a device from the device list by MAC address string.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getDeviceExt
methods.description: Gets a device from the device list using binary MAC address.

methods.name: wld_radio_updateNaStaMonitor
methods.description: Updates the non-associated station monitor for the radio.
